questions.question: Which line makes a value that can never change?
questions.why: let makes a constant. var makes a variable you can change.

questions.question: What is the type of price here?
questions.why: 4 has no fractional part, so Swift infers Int. Write 4.0 or let price: Double = 4 for a Double.

questions.question: What is 17 / 5 when both are Int?
questions.why: Dividing two Int values gives a whole number and drops the fraction. 17 % 5 would give the remainder, 2.

questions.question: What does this print?
questions.detail:
let n = 3
print("n squared is \(n * n)")
questions.why: Anything inside \( and ) in a string is worked out and put into the text.

questions.question: Which condition is true when x is between 1 and 10, including both?
questions.why: Both parts must hold, so use &&. >= and <= include the end points.
